faq1Q: Will my card be charged immediately?
faq1A: Only sandbox/bank-transfer flows are open per configuration. LIVE payment needs separate approval.
faq2A: Yes — cancel before the service starts according to order status and published policy.
faq3A: No. Couple Space only after an independent two-sided invite and consent.
faq4A: Only to coordinate the selected package — never as a psychological diagnosis.
